title: Unit – 4 : Session – 7 : SLO – 1  |  Binary Search Trees — Insertion Operation
sections: In BST insertion, first compare the new value with the ROOT (current node).
If the new value to be inserted is smaller, go to the LEFT child.
If the new value to be inserted is larger, go to the RIGHT child.
To insert a new element in BST; continue until an appropriate LEAF (NULL) position is found.
After finding appropriate position the new node is inserted at the LEAF (NULL link) location.
II. Algorithm to Insert a Value in a BST
SET TREE -> LEFT = TREE -> RIGHT = NULL
